limitations: Pinned warm-cache focused checks, not a full-root or CI build.
Generic direct replacement; library calibration requires the explicit matching Preorder.
No well-foundedness, ID1 accessibility, arithmetic or whole-source promotion.
TARGETS registry and source manuscripts unchanged.
SourceControlNonperiodicity uses explicit Code/evaln stages, not identified tape steps or a whole source hardness theorem.
Quotient domination uses existential checked positive-path certificates, not an unbounded relation decision or full direct multiset/well-foundedness result.
Blank-machine simulation establishes the actual transition clock, primitive recursion and termination calibration only; no undecidability or parity claim.
Direct quotient certificates are existential witnesses with explicit decoded endpoints, not a primitive-recursive checker, arithmetic representation or well-foundedness result.
Blank-halting reduction preserves the fixed actual table encoding and terminal bridge; no timing equality, parity or full source hardness claim.
Direct quotient checker primitive recursion retains actual encoding instances and fixed signature/arity/context parameters; no arithmetic or well-foundedness claim.
Machine-clock control uses the explicit actual table enumeration and transition semantics; no identification with a different clock or full source hardness claim.
Ordinary-arithmetic direct replacement is standard-natural-number representation with explicit context/list decoding and fixed signature/arity/context, not a carrier, ID1 or well-foundedness theorem.
The machine-halting conjunction concerns the original arithmetic equations only, not source-language gadgets, complexity bounds or the whole hardness theorem.
Canonical carrier calibration and preservation keep explicit subtype closure; no accessibility, ID1 or well-foundedness claim.
Parametric collapse retains arbitrary G and the explicit identity-majorization hypothesis for finite values; no G computability or source-gadget claim.
Coefficient-one collapse retains strict monotonicity and identity-majorization hypotheses for generic G; no higher-head or source-gadget identification.
Represented carrier formulas preserve failed-context/list rejection, empty-list vacuity and explicit subtype closure; no type-specific C_tau, ID1 or well-foundedness claim.
Typed canonical carrier calibration is syntactic typedness under subtype closure, not C_tau, accessibility, ID1, primitive recursion or arithmetic representation.
Parametric source successor retains the literal source S and actual full assignment with shared positive-raw valuations; no other gadget transfer or full theorem claim.
Typed-carrier formulas express syntax typedness under actual type and Context decoding; concrete calibration retains subtype closure. No C_tau, I, ID1 or well-foundedness claim.
Literal atomic eraser and addition only; no constant-one, nested gadget or complexity inference.
Literal typed application confinement and representative-code congruence only; actual primary appArgument does not add a positive reduction step. No numeric, primitive-recursive or ID1 claim.
